name: RANHILL
recent: Ranhill Utilities 在2026年11月17日公布最新季度业绩，营收6.515亿令吉，净利约3,000万令吉，水与电力业务收入增长。公司将于2026年12月2日召开第十二届常年股东大会，议程包括续聘核数师、更新股票回购授权及关联交易授权。此外，Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments 在10月至11月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
notable: 公布最新季度业绩，营收6.515亿令吉，净利约3,000万令吉。
将于2026年12月2日召开第十二届常年股东大会。
risks: Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments 在近期多次申报大股东权益变动。
earnings: 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收6.570亿令吉，净利7,008万令吉，净利率10.7%；营收环比增7.3%，净利环比增20.0%；营收同比增30.1%，净利同比增294.3%。

recent_en: Ranhill Utilities announced its latest quarterly results on 17 Nov 2026, with revenue of RM651.5 million and net profit of about RM30 million, as water and power revenue grew. Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments also filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November.
notable_en: Announced latest quarterly results with revenue of RM651.5 million and net profit of about RM30 million.
risks_en: Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments filed multiple substantial shareholder changes recently.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM657.0 million and net profit RM70.1 million, with a net margin of 10.7%; revenue rose 7.3% QoQ and net profit 20.0% QoQ; revenue grew 30.1% YoY and net profit 294.3% YoY.
